items.title: Don Alias interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: And the fact that I played drums on the record, I played drums on “Miles Runs the Voodoo Down”... Herbie, you know, face it. He would always get the musicians that would do what he wanted to have done.

ctx.x: No. No. For us, no. And now I’m thinking about for the instrumentalists, Miles may have had some sketches, a little bit of this and that and this and that and this and that. But then again, the secret is his ability to hire musicians to do what he wants. That, I mean, that’s what he had down to a tee, to hire the right guys. He always did it. I mean Herbie, you know, face it. He would always get the musicians that would do what he wanted to have done. So they may have had some sketches, like little things written…
Yeah it doesn’t list that specifically.
